title: Remove “Make This App Live” UI and /publish-help route

requirements.summary: Remove the “Make This App Live” CTA from the Landing Page and eliminate its navigation handler and Rocket icon usage.
acceptanceCriteria: LandingPage no longer renders a button labeled “Make This App Live”.
The navigate handler that routes to /publish-help is removed from LandingPage.
LandingPage builds with no unused-import lint/type errors after removing Rocket icon usage.

file_operations.description: Remove the “Make This App Live” Button UI from the landing CTA group; delete the handleNavigateToPublishHelp click handler and any references; remove the Rocket import from lucide-react (and any other now-unused imports) so the file compiles cleanly.

requirements.summary: Remove the “Make This App Live” menu item from the authenticated UserProfile dropdown and eliminate its navigation handler and Rocket icon usage.
acceptanceCriteria: UserProfile dropdown no longer contains a menu item labeled “Make This App Live”.
The navigate handler that routes to /publish-help is removed from UserProfile.
UserProfile builds with no unused-import lint/type errors after removing Rocket icon usage.

file_operations.description: Remove the dropdown menu item labeled “Make This App Live”; delete the handleNavigateToPublishHelp function and its onClick wiring; remove the Rocket import from lucide-react (and any other now-unused imports) to avoid lint/type errors.

requirements.summary: Remove the /publish-help route from the TanStack Router route tree and ensure the PublishHelpPage is not included in the shipped bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/App.tsx no longer imports PublishHelpPage and no longer registers a route with path /publish-help.
PublishHelpPage is removed (or otherwise not reachable/compiled) and there are no broken imports.
Navigating to /publish-help no longer resolves to an in-app help page (route is absent).

file_operations.description: Remove the PublishHelpPage import; remove the publishHelpRoute definition (path /publish-help) and remove it from the routeTree children so /publish-help is no longer part of the router configuration.
Delete the PublishHelpPage implementation file so it is no longer compiled/shipped, ensuring no remaining imports reference it.
